summary: Tested Super Admin subscription management (PUT /platform/saas/orgs/{id}/admin, GET history, admin_orgs) and the Abbonamenti → Organizzazioni UI (filters, SubscriptionEditDialog, tabs, summary & save, history, cancel, mobile 390px). 15/15 backend pytest tests pass covering security (QA org admin → 403 for PUT and GET history), active+bronze with limits 1/10, active+gold with limits -1/-1, max_users override on bronze, suspended, expired, active with past access_end → expired, trial with trial_end+20d → mode=trial & days_left≈20, status 'auto' restoration, history row shape (field/old/new/admin_email/at/reason), and validations (active without plan → 400, max_users=0 → 400, invalid date → 400, invalid plan 'platinum' → 400). UI test: created a dedicated TEST org, verified saas-filters (saas-search, saas-filter-plan/status/expiry), opened sub-edit-dialog via saas-edit-{id}, switched sub-tab-formula/date/stato/custom/storico, set plan silver, status active, used sub-extend-30, sub-save showed sub-confirm summary with pending diffs, sub-confirm-save persisted and closed dialog, Storico tab listed 5 history items, sub-cancel closes without saving. Cleaned up: TEST org deleted via DELETE /api/platform/organizations/{id} (200) and its saas_admin_history rows removed from Mongo. No real org touched.

issues: iubenda cookie banner overlays the bottom of the dialog/table and intercepts clicks until accepted/dismissed; not a bug of this feature but worth noting for UX on mobile. Desktop dialog layout is fine with internal scroll (max-h-[92dvh]).

critical_code_review_comments: subscriptions.admin_edit builds `prev` only from ADMIN_FIELDS + trial_start/trial_end (OK) and compares via `(prev or None) != (new or None)` — this coerces falsy values to None, so toggling comp from False to False or notes '' to '' never records history (good), but a change from False→True on comp when previously missing would still be recorded (expected). No real bug.

org_state uses adm.get('access_end') for `access_end` only when a_status=='active' — if admin sets status='active' with past access_end the response correctly flips mode to 'expired' and access_end is None in response. Verified in test_07.
SubscriptionEditDialog.save() does not re-prompt if sub_confirm is dismissed with Esc; harmless. Dialog overflow handling (max-h-[92dvh] overflow-y-auto) is correct for mobile.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. Reusable regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter104_sub_admin.py (needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME in env). The platform create-org endpoint is POST /api/platform/organizations (not /orgs). Delete requires body {confirm_name: <nome>}. Each new cliente org auto-initializes a 14d GOLD trial via SAAS.init_trial.
